notes.title: Observe Demo Release!
notes.notes:
As of today, the Demo 1.0.0 version of Observe is available to play for free on your steam account! Play through ~45 minutes of content, 2 separate batches of levels with distinct mechanics and get a glimpse of what it means to "Observe".

Look forward to many more posts about the upcoming full release of Observe later this year! These will feature talk about new worlds, new mechanics and how we're making fulfilling levels with them.

Wishlist the game and tell us what you thought about the demo here: https://discord.gg/NxjvrtyEcR
